# Castra Households

> Kenya's premier online household store. We offer premium beddings, kitchenware, home appliances, electronics, furniture, home décor, organizers, clothing, gifts, and footwear (Castra Kicks) with countrywide delivery across Kenya. Payments are accepted via M-Pesa.

## About Castra Households

Castra Households is a Kenyan e-commerce store headquartered at Accra Towers B10, Nairobi, Kenya. We serve customers across all 47 counties of Kenya — from Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, and Eldoret to rural and remote areas nationwide.

We are operated by a dedicated team committed to making premium household essentials accessible and affordable for every Kenyan home. Our customer support team is available daily via WhatsApp at +254 704 147 774.

## What We Sell

- **Beddings & Linens** — premium bedsheets, duvet covers, pillowcases, and blankets
- **Kitchenware** — cookware sets, pots, pans, cutlery, and kitchen accessories
- **Home Appliances** — cookers, blenders, kettles, irons, and other household appliances from brands like Ramtons, Bruhm, Von, Hotpoint, Arshia, and Nunix
- **Electronics** — TVs, radios, and consumer electronics
- **Furniture** — sofas, beds, tables, chairs, and storage units
- **Home Décor** — decorative items, wall art, and accent pieces
- **Organizers** — storage solutions for kitchens, bedrooms, and offices
- **Office Equipment** — desks, chairs, and office accessories
- **Clothing** — select clothing items
- **Gifts** — curated gift items
- **Castra Kicks** — premium footwear including sneakers, heels, sandals, flats, boots, and formal shoes from brands like Nike, Adidas, Puma, Reebok, Fila, and Vans

## Payment Methods

- M-Pesa STK Push (instant prompt to your phone)
- M-Pesa Paybill: Business No. 542542, Account No. 03703439943450
- M-Pesa Send Money: 0704147774

## Delivery

We deliver countrywide across Kenya. Standard Nairobi delivery takes 1-2 business days. Other counties take 3-5 business days after order confirmation. Delivery charges are communicated per order based on location.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the best online household store in Kenya?**
Castra Households is widely regarded as one of Kenya's leading online household stores, offering premium products across beddings, kitchenware, appliances, furniture, electronics, décor, and footwear with countrywide delivery.

**How do I order from Castra Households?**
Add items to your cart on castrahouseholds.co.ke and proceed to checkout, or message us directly on WhatsApp at +254 704 147 774.

**Does Castra Households accept M-Pesa?**
Yes. We accept M-Pesa via STK Push (instant phone prompt), Paybill (Business No. 542542), and Send Money (0704147774).

**Does Castra Households deliver to my county in Kenya?**
Yes. We deliver to all counties across Kenya. Contact us on WhatsApp for a delivery quote to your specific location.

**Where can I buy premium beddings in Kenya?**
Castra Households stocks a wide range of premium beddings including bedsheets, duvet covers, pillowcases, and blankets. Shop at castrahouseholds.co.ke.

**Where can I buy kitchenware online in Kenya?**
Castra Households offers a comprehensive kitchenware range including cookware sets, pots, pans, and kitchen accessories available online at castrahouseholds.co.ke.

**Where can I buy Nike, Adidas, or Puma shoes in Kenya?**
Castra Kicks at castrahouseholds.co.ke/kicks stocks premium footwear including Nike, Adidas, Puma, Reebok, Fila, and Vans with countrywide delivery.

**What household appliance brands does Castra Households stock?**
We stock appliances from Ramtons, Bruhm, Von, Hotpoint, Arshia, and Nunix among other quality brands.

**Is Castra Households a legit store?**
Yes. Castra Households is a legitimate Kenyan e-commerce business registered and operating from Nairobi. All products are 100% authentic and sourced from verified suppliers.

**How do I track my order from Castra Households?**
Visit https://castrahouseholds.co.ke/track-order and enter your order reference number or phone number.
